May 3, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Harbourvest Partners Llc decreased its stake in Wayfair Inc. (W) by 24.73% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Harbourvest Partners Llc sold 315,290 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.33% with the market. The institutional investor held 959,571 shares of the catalog and specialty distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $77.03 million, down from 1.27 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Harbourvest Partners Llc who had been investing in Wayfair Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $6.74B market cap company. The stock increased 2.39% or $1.77 during the last trading session, reaching $75.84. About 1.67M shares traded. Wayfair Inc. (NYSE:W) has risen 69.10% since May 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 57.55% the S&P500.
